method: Native screenshots inspected at full view and in contact sheets; button visibility also checked by XCTest label and frame width.

Final iPad mini completion alerts, post-operation review screens, active keyboard and finished input reviewed at full size and in contact sheets; no blocked return control or overlap.

historicalFinding: First native screenshots showed icon-only return controls despite correct accessibility labels. Replaced semantic Label with explicit HStack and added minimum rendered-width assertions; final previews show full text.

historicalFindings.finding: Compact native toolbar collapsed Label to an icon although its accessibility label contained a destination.
historicalFindings.resolution: Explicit arrow/text layout; final screenshots and rendered-width assertions cover all 17 roots on both devices.

historicalFindings.finding: Completion alert acknowledgement remained disabled after save or reload.
historicalFindings.resolution: Busy pages block hit testing without passing a disabled environment into alerts. Final screenshots show enabled acknowledgements and alert-free review screens; tests assert dismissal.

historicalFindings.finding: Share action was classified as a button by a test, but iOS 26 exposes it as a collection cell.
historicalFindings.resolution: System share sheet is visibly present; final test scopes to ActivityListView and supports either native element type.
